title: Nashville's Honky-Tonk Walking Sightseeing Pub Crawl
includes: Sightseeing Tour AND Pub Crawl combined
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All participants MUST be 21+ with a valid ID.

We have a minimum of 7 people required to run the tours. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Nashville's ORIGINAL pub crawl: The Honky Tonk Pub Crawl is a sightseeing tour and pub crawl combined with a COMEDIAN Tour Guide. Nashville's Best Walking Tour/Pub Crawl Combo! You get to do a pub crawl while, at the same time, taking a walking sightseeing tour of historic downtown Nashville along the way! You'll be drinkin' and learnin' as you hear stories of the history of Nashville and laughing along the way. Some pub crawls offer "trivia" or all-inclusive with tiny drinks that you don't even get to pick! Patrons will not only get a good time, but they will receive discounts and freebies to bars and restaurants downtown. You'll get much more bang for your buck! With the discounts and freebies, the tour will pay for itself!
